title: Stock Trading Simulator
description: A web-based stock market trading simulator with minimal capital ($1 starting) for learning day trading strategies.
user_intent: Build a web app for simulating stock market day trading with absolutely minimal initial investment; $1 starting capital and see where it goes.

architecture.overview: Three-tier architecture: React frontend, Python FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL database

layers.name: Frontend
layers.responsibility: User interface for viewing portfolio, executing trades, viewing charts

layers.name: Backend API
layers.responsibility: REST API for authentication, portfolio operations, market data queries

layers.name: Infrastructure
layers.responsibility: Data persistence and real-time market data

market_data_fetcher.description: Fetches and caches real-time stock prices from external API
responsibilities: Query stock prices from IEX Cloud
Cache prices in Redis with TTL
Handle API rate limits and failures

portfolio_engine.description: Manages user portfolio state: holdings, cash, profit/loss, position sizing
responsibilities: Track user holdings (quantity, avg cost basis)
Calculate portfolio value, P&L, asset allocation
Enforce minimum account size and position limits

trading_engine.description: Executes trades and manages order state
responsibilities: Validate orders (sufficient funds, valid symbols, trading hours)
Execute orders against current market prices

backtest_runner.description: Simulates trading strategies against historical price data
responsibilities: Calculate Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, win rate
Alerts for price targets or drawdown limits

assumptions: Real-time market data via IEX Cloud API (free tier sufficient for learning)
Trading hours: 9:30 AM — 4:00 PM Eastern Time (US market hours only)
No shorting, margin, or leverage allowed
Single user system initially (no multi-tenant complexity)
No transaction fees or slippage modeling
Trades execute at current market price (last trade price from API)

critical_decisions.decision: Use real-time API data instead of historical simulation
critical_decisions.rationale: More engaging for learners; real-time feedback on decisions
critical_decisions.tradeoff: Requires external API; introduces rate-limiting and cost considerations

critical_decisions.rationale: Simpler for beginners; reduces model complexity

critical_decisions.tradeoff: Not realistic for high-frequency strategies or market impact

critical_decisions.rationale: Faster MVP; adequate for personal learning tool
critical_decisions.tradeoff: Would need rearchitecture for production SaaS

constraints: Budget: Free or $10/month (no expensive cloud services)
Hosting: Self-hosted Docker on $5/month VPS or free tier cloud
API costs: IEX Cloud free tier (100 requests/month or ~$10 paid)
Development time: Target 40-60 hours for MVP
Data retention: 90 days of trade history minimum
success_criteria: User can create account and log in
User can view current portfolio with starting $1 capital
User can execute buy/sell orders at current market prices
User can see trade history with P&L for each trade
User can run a 30-day backtest on a simple strategy
System handles 500+ concurrent users without significant latency
P&L and portfolio calculations are accurate within 0.01%
